import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int N = 1 << 20;
    static int[][] p = new int[M][M];
    static int[] f = new int[N], g = new int[N];
    static int[][] idx = new int[2][N];
    static int[] rev = new int[N];
    static int[] matched = new int[M];
    static int[][] adj = new int[M][M];
    static int n;
    static final int M = 21;

    static int fpow(int x, int y) {
        int ret = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) ret = (int)((long)ret * x % mod);
            x = (int)((long) x * x % mod);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static void work(int[] f, List<Integer> l, List<Integer> r, List<Integer> subgraph, int[] idxArr) {
        List<Pair> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x : l) {
            for (int y : r) {
                edges.add(new Pair(x, y));
            }
        }
        int size = edges.size();
        int totalMasks = 1 << size;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
            int rate = 1;
            int newmask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    rate = (int)((long)rate * p[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y] % mod);
                    adj[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y] = 1;
                } else {
                    rate = (int)((long)rate * (mod + 1 - p[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y]) % mod);
                    adj[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int gr : subgraph) {
                List<Integer> perm = new ArrayList<>(l);
                List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((gr >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        indices.add(i + n);
                    }
                }
                boolean flag = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < perm.size(); i++) {
                        if (adj[perm.get(i)][indices.get(i)] == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        flag = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(indices));
                if (flag) {
                    newmask |= (1 << idxArr[gr]);
                }
            }
            f[newmask] = (f[newmask] + rate) % mod;
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> list) {
        int i = list.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && list.get(i) >= list.get(i + 1)) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = list.size() - 1;
        while (list.get(j) <= list.get(i)) j--;
        Collections.swap(list, i, j);
        for (int a = i + 1, b = list.size() - 1; a < b; a++, b--) {
            Collections.swap(list, a, b);
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j + n] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j + n] = (int)((long)p[i][j + n] * fpow(100, mod - 2) % mod);
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(p[0][n]);
            return;
        }

        int m1 = n / 2;
        int m2 = n - m1;

        int cnt = 0, cnt2 = 0;
        List<Integer> sub1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sub2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == m1) {
                idx[0][mask] = cnt++;
                sub1.add(mask);
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == m2) {
                idx[1][mask] = cnt2++;
                sub2.add(mask);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sub2.size(); i++) {
            int mask = sub2.get(i);
            for (int bigmask = 0; bigmask < (1 << cnt2); bigmask++) {
                if (((bigmask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    rev[bigmask] |= (1 << idx[0][(1 << n) - 1 - mask]);
                }
            }
        }

        List<Integer> l1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> l2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> r = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = n; i < n + n; i++) {
            r.add(i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m1; i++) l1.add(i);
        for (int i = m1; i < n; i++) l2.add(i);

        work(f, l1, r, sub1, idx[0]);
        work(g, l2, r, sub2, idx[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << cnt); mask++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    f[mask] = (f[mask] + f[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        int totalMask = (1 << cnt2);
        for (int mask = 1; mask < totalMask; mask++) {
            int w = (int)((1 - f[(1 << cnt) - 1 - rev[mask]] + mod) % mod);
            ans = (ans + (long)w * g[mask] % mod) % mod;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static class Pair {
        int x, y;
        Pair(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }
}
